decisions.question: Classify S79's amend of bus-api@v2 (the bus is running from the moment start() begins, so the work start() runs makes activations, subscriptions and module references as after start(), a nested start() does nothing, and a removeTopic it calls throws StateError) against bus-api@v2's Breaking list: compatible within v2, or breaking and to the human?

options.label: Compatible: apply within v2
options.consequence: G34, G9 and G42 state it; a Versioning entry records it; no version bump. Rests on the contract's 'a new guarantee that existing fixtures still pass'.

options.label: Breaking: report a skill stop for the orchestrator (DEC-686)
options.consequence: One more orchestrator decision and, if upheld, a v3 of a contract no package implements, with every consumer citation moving again inside this intake.

decisions.why: G34 said a bus is bootstrapping 'until start()' and that start() 'ends bootstrapping in three steps', which leaves a call made during the steps unstated; G42's 'before start()' inherits the same ambiguity. The one call where the earlier text implied an answer is a removeTopic from a bootstrap subscription's callback in step 2, which runs within a connection, not a delivery, so G9's 'during a delivery' did not cover it; the amend makes it throw. That edge sits on the Breaking list's 'which operation throws what', which is why I mark would_have_asked. It breaks no consumer: only bus-api's own suite and flutter-binding@v2's adapter suite call removeTopic, both outside start(), and no consumer spec mentions it. Replay settles the rest: both stand-in runtimes already set running before step 1 and pass every suite that imports nidana_dart_runtime; and on a runtime seeded to stay bootstrapping until start() returns, every suite except bus-api's extended cases still passes, so no consumer fixture relies on either reading. No package implements v2 and no phase has shipped. bus-api@v2 is draft, so the in-version precedent (DEC-186, DEC-244) applies; DEC-688 governs stable contracts. Signal that would have changed my mind: a consumer fixture or plan that calls removeTopic or activates a MODULE/PAGE topology from a callback during start() and expects the other behavior.
evidence: bus-api@v2 G9, G34, G42 and Versioning (Breaking and Compatible lists)
